text:
customer_jane: getting 401 invalid_api_key from hosted API after updating our mobile SDK. used the SDK helper but still 401. can someone take a quick look?

support_erin: can you paste the exact request (headers only) you see from the client? quick guess: malformed auth header or newline/whitespace.

customer_jane: here's the header captured from our network logs:

```
Authorization:Bearerabcd1234efgh5678
Content-Type: application/json
```

support_erin: ah — I think that's it. the server expects a space after the scheme: `Authorization: Bearer <token>` not `Authorization:Bearer<token>`. some HTTP frameworks are strict about the space. can you try adding the space and retry?

customer_jane: trying now... yep that fixed it. no more 401s. wow. we thought the SDK helper did that, turned out our wrapper removed the space when joining header parts.

eng_dan: noted. i'll add a defensive validation in the SDK to normalize the header (ensure a single space after scheme) and add a unit test. also put a short note in the troubleshooting guide.

support_erin: filing an internal ticket to add a small diagnostic message in support replies when we see an Authorization header without a space. ticket: INF-4219.

customer_jane: thanks all! appreciated :raised_hands:

deploy-bot: deployment completed for branch fix/sdk-auth-normalize (PR #452)
